items.title: Can You Make Money Off Salesforce Stock Now?
items.summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock has dropped 13% from its early September high of about $264. You make money from here only if the stock recovers and Salesforce keeps customers paying for Agentforce and Slack. Should you buy Salesforce stock after this drop? To assess that, we have to look at Salesforce's history of dips and how it subsequently recovered.

items.title: AI Will Revolutionize Medicine. This Company Provides the Plumbing.
items.summary: Veeva Systems  is making that transformation happen.  The Pleasanton, Calif.–based company develops software for biotechnology and pharmaceutical customers to manage everything from research and development and regulatory submissions to day-to-day commercial operations.  Its software was originally built atop  Salesforce  but has since expanded to stand-alone applications.

items.title: How Has Microsoft's Story Changed In A Year?
items.summary: Microsoft's management stressed Copilot and AI agents on its fiscal Q4 2026 call. The stock has returned 34% in three months, against 2.5% for the S&P 500. Microsoft (MSFT) needs fast Azure growth and revenue from Copilot's paid seats to justify that gain. A year ago management led with a different topic, tied to a large part of Microsoft. What was it exactly.

items.title: Which Dates Could Move Microsoft Stock Most?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) stock has gained about 34% in three months, and you may wonder whether it can hold that gain. Management expects about $175 billion of capital spending in calendar 2026 and has said the spending may lower operating margins. A few dated events will show whether that spending is paying off. Below are the earnings reports and other dates most likely to move Microsoft stock over the next six months.

items.title: IBM Jumps 5% as Bob Coding Agent Gains Self-Hosted Deployment; Salesforce Rises 3%, Palantir Inches Higher
items.summary: IBM stock surged far ahead of the broader software sector after quietly extending its Bob coding agent into a corner of the market most AI platforms cannot reach. Whether the move signals a lasting repricing or a one-day pop depends on details IBM has not yet disclosed.

items.title: How Much Upside Is Left In Microsoft Stock?
items.summary: Microsoft (MSFT) shares returned 37% over the past three months, against 2.6% for the S&P 500. Even so, Microsoft's P/E, the price divided by a year of profit, is 28.3. That is below 31.8, the stock's average at the last twelve quarter-ends, leaving out readings above 100. A run that big makes buyers wary, but the shares cost less per dollar of profit than usual. So how much upside is left in Microsoft stock at today's price.

items.title: UiPath and Snowflake Jump 5% on UiPath’s BDO and Snowflake Updates; Salesforce Moves Up 3%
items.summary: UiPath just handed auditors an AI agent and plugged Snowflake directly into its automation platform, and investors are betting those moves signal something bigger than a routine partnership announcement.
